facts.fact: Birr Metrics reports the Addis Ababa Finance Bureau ordered 48 of the city's largest-spending agencies to use the Electronic Government Procurement platform.

Addis Ababa's Procurement Directive No. 197/2019 requires bid announcements, document sales, clarifications, bid openings and contract administration to be done entirely through a digital system, per Birr Metrics.
Officials say over 308 billion Birr in procurement was facilitated electronically across 169 federal budgetary institutions and 93 branch offices in the 2024/25 fiscal year.
